messages:
Sam H.: quick sync: we need a concrete policy for gateable telemetry changes. i've sketched three vectors: billing-impacting fields, high-cardinality tags, and behavioral flags. thoughts?
Priya M.: love that breakdown. important distinction: billing-impacting => must be client-gated or explicit tenant opt-in. otherwise we risk silent cost shifts.
Ethan R.: Agreed. operationally, server transforms are ok for low-risk reshapes (e.g., normalize timestamp formats) but not for anything that changes billing keys or the dimensionality of metrics.
Lina V.: ops concern: transforms at ingest add CPU and make tracing of original payload harder. we should keep an immutable raw topic that copies the original event for debugging/backfill.
Sam H.: good point. propose: ingest router writes raw->archive and emits a transformed stream for downstream, controlled by gate mode. archive TTL configurable per-tenant.
Priya M.: +1. also need a way to advertise schema version to analytics: embed a stable header `X-Rdwd-Schema-Ver`. downstream analytics can join on that for joins/backfills.
Ethan R.: what about the gating control surface? env var, config push, or per-request header? my vote: three-layer control: global default, tenant override in config, and per-request override header for migrations.
Lina V.: per-request header is useful for canaries but dangerous if customers can set it and bypass billing protections. limit header use to requests authenticated as internal/migration service.
Sam H.: agreed. define header as opaque token + gate blob, signed by a migration key. example: `X-Rdwd-Gate: sig|{"gate":"new_kv","mode":"transform"}`.
Priya M.: careful: header size and parsing cost. prefer a short gate id and mode rather than full JSON. e.g., `X-Rdwd-Gate: new_kv=transform;ver=2;sig=abc123`.
Ethan R.: +1 for compact. router validates signature and enforces a max header size.
Lina V.: tracing: keep original fields as metadata on the trace span so we can debug transforms. don't drop originals until backfill window closes.
Sam H.: backfill ownership? product-metrics or data-platform? i'd default to product-metrics but require a cost estimate and bill-owner signoff before any historical rewrite.
Priya M.: billing needs veto power if a backfill increases storage/query costs. RFC should include a cost estimate template: QPS, added storage GB, estimated query-cost delta.
Ethan R.: sampling interactions: if a transform expands cardinality we should temporarily increase sampling to capture representative samples for testing before full rollout. include perf test harness.
Lina V.: ops-bot: note from last run -> index growth spike when we enabled an unbounded tag. please ensure pre-prod perf test and automatic rate-limiting for new-tag cardinality.
ops-bot: ALERT: prior rollout of unbounded-label caused 42% index size increase in staging. Recommend enforced cardinality cap and quota check. :warning:
Sam H.: policy proposal: gating modes = passthru, transform, client-reject. Each gate has attributes: rollout_days, cardinality_limit, backfill_required. RFC will include decision matrix.
Priya M.: migration plan item: analytics needs a shim layer with mapping functions for old->new keys. include SQL examples in RFC and compatibility queries.
Ethan R.: add a telemetry SDK change: SDK should expose a `telemetry_gate()` helper that adds the signed header during migration flows. document keys rotation.
Lina V.: also add monitoring: metric to count gated events, transform failures, quarantine queue length, and per-tenant cardinality delta. wire alerts for sudden spikes.
Sam H.: action items: 1) i'll draft the RFC with policy and matrix, 2) Ethan will add SDK header helper PR, 3) Lina will design perf test and staging canary, 4) Priya will prepare cost-estimate template for billing signoff. target EOD Fri for drafts.
Priya M.: i'll also add a short glossary: billing_key vs attribution_key vs analytic_key. important to standardize naming.
Ethan R.: any objections to keeping raw archive for 90 days by default? helps for debugging but costs more.
Lina V.: default 30 days, but make 90d opt-in per-tenant with billing approval. ops can't absorb 90d for everyone.
Sam H.: ok final calls: 30d raw archive default, gate id compact header, signed overrides for migration, card caps enforced, backfill cost estimate required. we'll iterate in RFC. thanks all. :thumbsup:
